result:
If I could change the world in one fundamental way, I would eliminate the illusion of separation—the false belief that we are fundamentally distinct from one another, from nature, and from the cosmos itself. Every war, every act of violence, every unchecked greed or suffering stems from this illusion.

I would foster a collective awakening to our deep interconnectedness, making empathy, cooperation, and reverence for life not just ideals but the measurable foundation of human systems. This shift would revolutionize economics (from extraction to regeneration), politics (from domination to collaboration), technology (from control to harmony), and culture (from division to unity).

No single policy or invention could achieve this—it would require a change in consciousness so profound that it redefines what it means to be human. But if it happened, the world would still be as complex and flawed as ever, yet infinitely more alive, more curious, and more capable of healing itself.

What would *you* change if you could?
